name.description: Display name of the MCP server, shown beside its ID in the catalog editor. Changes no behavior and no tool name; defaults to the ID.

cwd.description: Optional process working directory, relative to the session cwd.

env.description: Environment values passed to the MCP process. Avoid placing secrets here; use env_from for secrets.

env_from.description: Map child environment names to names of variables in the backend environment; secret values are not stored in this file.

headers_from.description: Map HTTP header names to names of variables in the backend environment; secret values are not stored in this file.

oauth.description: OAuth 2.1 for a server that asks for it. With grant authorization_code, sign in once with `jad mcp login <category>/<name>`: the tokens are kept in <state>/.mcp-oauth/<category>/<name>.json (mode 0600) and refreshed during runs; a run never starts a sign-in, and a server whose tokens are missing or can no longer be refreshed fails the run with the login command named. With grant client_credentials no sign-in is needed. Do not also set an Authorization header in headers_from.

client_id.description: A client registered with the authorization server. Without it, authorization_code registers a client dynamically at sign-in. Required for client_credentials.

client_secret_from.description: Name of the backend environment variable that holds the client secret; needs client_id. Required for client_credentials.

scopes.description: Scopes to ask for at sign-in instead of the ones the server's metadata names. authorization_code only.

redirect_url.description: Where the browser is sent after sign-in. On an http loopback address with a port, jad mcp login waits for it there; with an https address, paste the address the browser was sent to. authorization_code only.

refresh_margin_ms.description: Refresh the access token this long before it expires; at most half the token's lifetime is used. authorization_code only.

timeout_ms.description: Connection and tool-call timeout. Defaults to 30000.

max_result_bytes.description: Maximum serialized MCP tool result content sent to the model. Defaults to 1048576.

resource_events_max.description: How many resource change notifications (resources/updated of a subscribed resource, resources/list_changed) are kept for this server, the newest first. They are listed by GET /api/sessions/<ref>/mcp-resources/events and told to the model at the start of its next turn. Defaults to 100.

max_tools.description: Maximum tools this server may expose. Every tools/list page is followed; a server that returns more tools, or keeps paginating past this count, fails the run with this key named. Defaults to 256.

max_schema_bytes.description: Maximum size of one tool input schema, counted as the JSON bytes the schema is held as. A larger tool is refused and named. Defaults to 65536.

max_description_bytes.description: Maximum size of one tool description, which is sent to the model with every request. A longer one is refused and the tool is named. Defaults to 4096.
